{
  "project_id": "P-SLE-ConnectivityAgMarketInfra",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Fragmented institutional framework and weak coordination among transport ministries and agencies may cause implementation delays and inefficiencies.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish clear coordination mechanisms through the NPSC, regular joint planning meetings, and a shared project management information system.",
      "evidence": "Key challenges in sectoral management include institutional fragmentation, insufficient funding, and capacity constraints (Section III.A)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "The PCIU procurement unit does not exist yet, risking procurement delays, non‑compliance and weak contract management.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Recruit qualified procurement staff before effectiveness, provide intensive training on World Bank regulations and STEP, and set up a robust record‑keeping system.",
      "evidence": "Procurement unit not currently established; staffing required before project effectiveness (Annex 6, point 2)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "High fiduciary risk due to limited MTA experience with World Bank financial management procedures.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Implement the FM Action Plan: hire FM specialist, internal auditor, adopt FM manual, and conduct regular external audits and supervision.",
      "evidence": "FM risk before mitigation rated ‘High’; weaknesses in control environment (Annex 7, point 3)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Extreme rainfall and flooding may damage bridges and link roads during construction or operation.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Apply climate‑resilient design standards (elevated decks, oversized culverts, scour protection) and schedule critical works outside peak rainy season.",
      "evidence": "Climate change expected to intensify heavy rainfall; bridges designed with flood‑resilient measures (Annex 5, Table 5.1)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Construction cost overruns of 25% or more could erode project economics.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Include contingency budgets, enforce strict contract price escalation clauses, and conduct regular cost‑control reviews.",
      "evidence": "Sensitivity analysis assumes 25% increase in capital costs; still viable (Annex 3, point 9)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Rainy season may halt bridge works using incremental launching, causing schedule slippage.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Develop a detailed construction schedule with weather buffers, and prioritize works on sites less exposed to floods.",
      "evidence": "Bridge construction uses incremental launching to avoid delays from prolonged rainy seasons (Section 9)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Procurement staff lack knowledge of World Bank Procurement Regulations and STEP, risking non‑compliance.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Provide regular procurement clinics, hands‑on STEP training, and mentorship from experienced World Bank procurement advisors.",
      "evidence": "Procurement risk assessment notes limited knowledge of World Bank’s Procurement Regulations and STEP (Annex 6, point 8)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Potential gender‑based violence and sexual harassment on public transport could undermine social acceptance.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Install CCTV, establish a hotline, conduct SH awareness campaigns, and enforce strict operator codes of conduct.",
      "evidence": "Component 1 includes CCTV to reduce harassment; SH action plan to be adopted (Section 1(b))."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Low mobile phone penetration among rural women may limit use of the upgraded AMIS platform.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Complement digital tools with community‑based dissemination, training sessions, and partnerships with women’s groups for information relay.",
      "evidence": "Rural women have limited access to smartphones; alternative communication channels recommended (Component 3, paragraph on AMIS)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "CERC funds may not be mobilized quickly enough in an emergency, reducing responsiveness.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Finalize CERC Manual and Emergency Action Plan before project start; conduct simulation exercises to test rapid fund release.",
      "evidence": "CERC component included to allow rapid reallocation of uncommitted funds (Component 5)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Absence of a systematic road‑safety database hampers evidence‑based safety interventions.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Develop a national road‑safety information system as part of the national road safety guidelines and integrate data collection into MTA operations.",
      "evidence": "No systematic database on road safety; data gaps noted (Section 8)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Funding gap for SCADeP bridge works relies on GoSL fiscal support, which may be constrained.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Secure binding fiscal commitment from GoSL, explore alternative financing (e.g., private sector lease‑operate‑own), and monitor disbursement milestones.",
      "evidence": "SCADeP bridges have a US$7.1 million gap; GoSL to cover US$3.1 million (Component 2, sub‑component b)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Weak internal controls increase risk of fraud, collusion and corruption in procurement and disbursements.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Enforce strict procurement transparency, publish bidding documents, use independent audit, and implement a robust grievance redress mechanism.",
      "evidence": "Procurement risk assessment highlights fraud and corruption risks; mitigation measures listed (Annex 6, Table 6.1)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Post‑project operation and maintenance funding for bridges and roads may be insufficient, threatening asset longevity.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Integrate O&M cost lines into the Road Maintenance Fund, establish user‑fee mechanisms where appropriate, and train local councils on asset management.",
      "evidence": "Assumption that funding is available for bridge and road maintenance after project closing (Critical Assumptions, point 2)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Delay in establishing the National Project Steering Committee within 60 days could weaken project oversight.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Include NPSC establishment as a pre‑effective condition and monitor compliance through the World Bank’s supervision team.",
      "evidence": "Legal covenant requires NPSC to be established within 60 days (Legal Covenants, Schedule 2, Section I.A.2(a))."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Design assumptions for flood levels may be inaccurate, reducing bridge resilience over its 100‑year design life.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate adaptive design margins, conduct periodic climate‑risk reassessments, and allow for retro‑fitting if future flood projections exceed design values.",
      "evidence": "Design flood levels may not fully capture future climate change; contractor must factor projected flood quantities (Annex 5)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R17",
      "description": "Agricultural market facilities may not meet climate‑resilient building codes, leading to damage from floods or heat.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Apply the climate‑resilient standards outlined in the ESMP, conduct third‑party inspections, and use weather‑resistant materials.",
      "evidence": "Market infrastructure to follow climate‑resilient building codes and include tree planting, solar power (Component 3)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R18",
      "description": "Private bus operators may be unable to meet lease payments, jeopardizing fleet renewal.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Perform rigorous financial viability assessments of operators, structure lease terms with flexible payment schedules, and provide technical assistance for revenue management.",
      "evidence": "Bus lease scheme aims to cover ~50 % of capital cost; feasibility depends on operator capacity (Component 1, sub‑component c)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R19",
      "description": "Inadequate data collection for AMIS could produce inaccurate market price information.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Standardize data collection protocols, train enumerators, and implement automated validation checks within the AMIS platform.",
      "evidence": "Challenges identified: limited capacity to integrate value chains and timely data collection for AMIS (Component 3, paragraph on AMIS)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R20",
      "description": "High road‑crash fatality rate may persist if safety features are not fully functional or maintained.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Install and regularly inspect safety features (guardrails, markings, signals), and enforce traffic regulations through SLRSA.",
      "evidence": "Sierra Leone has 33 road‑crash fatalities per 100 000; safety features to be installed (Component 1, sub‑component a)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R21",
      "description": "Recruitment delays for key PCIU staff (procurement specialist, FM specialist) could postpone project start‑up activities.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Launch competitive recruitment early, set firm hiring deadlines, and use interim consultants if needed.",
      "evidence": "PCIU to recruit procurement specialist, FM specialist before project effectiveness (Annex 6, Action 2 & 3)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R22",
      "description": "Political polarization may hinder adoption of transport policy reforms and budget allocations.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Engage political leaders early, build cross‑party consensus through the NPSC, and align reforms with national development plans.",
      "evidence": "Country context notes post‑conflict governance challenges and political polarization (Section A, Country Context)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R23",
      "description": "Extreme heat may degrade road and bridge pavements faster than anticipated, increasing maintenance costs.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Specify heat‑resistant materials in design specifications and schedule periodic condition assessments.",
      "evidence": "Extreme heat identified as a climate risk affecting pavement durability (Annex 5, Table 5.1)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R24",
      "description": "Insufficient competition in procurement could lead to higher prices and lower quality.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Aggregate small packages, conduct market outreach, and enforce transparent bidding processes with minimum competition thresholds.",
      "evidence": "Procurement risk assessment notes insufficient competition; mitigation includes aggregation and private‑sector sensitisation (Annex 6, Table 6.1)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R25",
      "description": "Weak grievance redress mechanisms may allow community dissatisfaction to grow, affecting project acceptance.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement the project‑specific grievance redress service, publicize procedures, and ensure timely response within set timelines.",
      "evidence": "Grievance redress services described in Section V and monitoring indicators (Project Management Support)."
    }
  ]
}
